findings.title: Replay rewrites already-valid stored tool names
findings.problem: _extract_tool_records now passes every stored metadata.tool_name through _normalize_tool_name, which lowercases, collapses consecutive underscores and strips leading/trailing underscores. Previously a stored tool_name was replayed verbatim. Bound MCP tools are named by agents/utils.py sanitize_tool_name, which lowercases and replaces invalid chars but does not collapse '__' or strip edge '_' (and appends a hash suffix on overflow), so a valid bound name like 'server__tool' or 'name_' replays as 'server_tool'/'name'.
findings.impact: Replayed AIMessage.tool_calls/ToolMessage names in native-tools mode can diverge from the currently bound tool names, so the model sees history calls to tools that do not exist and may imitate them. The available_tool_names filter normalizes both sides, so the record is not dropped, which hides the mismatch. Reachability to a user-visible failure is unconfirmed: it depends on tool names containing '__' or edge underscores.
findings.recommendation: Keep a stored name unchanged when it already fully matches [a-zA-Z0-9_-]+ and is <= MAX_TOOL_NAME_LENGTH; apply _normalize_tool_name only to invalid or overlong names (e.g. name if TOOL_NAME_REGEX.fullmatch(name) and len(name) <= MAX_TOOL_NAME_LENGTH else cls._normalize_tool_name(name)). Add a test that a valid name with '__' survives replay unchanged.

findings.impact: A required story acceptance criterion is only partially met; the exact broken-history shape from the incident (long title-cased sub-assistant display name with ' #N') has no regression guard.
findings.recommendation: Add a test that stores an 80+ char title-cased display name with spaces and a ' #2' suffix as metadata.tool_name and asserts _extract_tool_records (and build_for_request in NATIVE_TOOLS_MODE) yields a <= 64-char name matching [a-z0-9_-]+.
